# AgentX

AgentX is a terminal based AI agent for building and modifying real software projects.

## Core documentation

- https://agentx.js.org/docs/intro
- https://agentx.js.org/docs/installation
- https://agentx.js.org/docs/providers
- https://agentx.js.org/docs/local-models
- https://agentx.js.org/docs/architecture
- https://agentx.js.org/docs/commands
- https://agentx.js.org/docs/stacks
- https://agentx.js.org/docs/services
- https://agentx.js.org/docs/security
- https://agentx.js.org/docs/faq

## Workflow

AgentX follows a plan, read, execute, verify loop. It is designed to inspect an existing repository before editing and to use project checks as feedback.

## Install

`npm install -g @agent-qofeno/agentx-cli`
